en: What do diyas symbolize during Diwali?
zh: 屠妖节中的油灯象征着什么？
options: Wealth and prosperity 	财富与繁荣
Light overcoming darkness 光明战胜黑暗
Friendship and unity 友谊与团结
The harvest season 收获季节can
explanation: Diyas represent the victory of good over evil and the triumph of light over darkness. 油灯象征善良战胜邪恶，也象征光明驱散黑暗

en: What do people usually prepare before Deepavali?
zh: 屠妖节前，人们通常会做什么准备？
options: Cleaning the house 打扫房屋
Decorating the home 装饰家居
Buying new clothes 购买新衣
All of the above 以上皆是
explanation: Families clean, decorate, and buy new clothes to welcome prosperity and fresh beginnings. 人们会打扫、装饰并购买新衣，以迎接繁荣与新的开始。

en: What is the colourful artwork drawn at the entrance of Indian homes called?
zh: 印度家庭门前常见的彩色图案叫什么？
options: Kolam
Rangoli
Henna
Mandala
explanation: Rangoli is a traditional floor art created to welcome guests, deities, and positive energy. Rangoli 是传统地绘，用来迎接客人、神明和正能量。

en: Why do people wear new clothes during Deepavali?
zh: 为什么屠妖节要穿新衣？
options: To show wealth 展示财富
To symbolize new beginnings 象征新的开始
To follow tradition 遵循传统
Because shops offer discounts 因为商店有折扣
explanation: New clothes represent renewal, purity, and stepping into a fresh, blessed year. 穿新衣象征新的开始、纯洁与迎接更好的未来。

en: Why are many sweets prepared during Deepavali?
zh: 为什么屠妖节会准备许多甜食？
options: To symbolize sweetness and happiness 象征甜蜜与幸福
To share joy with others 分享喜悦
To offer to gods and guests 供奉神明与招待客人
All of the above 以上皆是
explanation: Sweets represent joy, gratitude, and the sweetness of new beginnings. 甜食象征喜悦、感恩和新开始的甜蜜。

en: What does gifting cookies and snacks during Deepavali represent?
zh: 屠妖节时，亲友之间互赠年饼和甜点代表什么？
options: Blessings 祝福
Friendship 友谊
Sharing happiness 分享快乐
All of the above 以上皆是
explanation: Exchanging festive treats strengthens bonds and spreads joy and blessings. 互赠节庆食品象征友谊、祝福与分享快乐。

en: Laddu is a round Indian sweet. What does its round shape symbolize?
zh: 印度传统甜点 Laddu 通常是圆形的，它象征什么？
options: Unity 团结
Wholeness 圆满
Happiness 幸福
All of the above 以上皆是
explanation: The round shape represents completeness, unity, and joyful celebration. 圆形象征圆满、团结与幸福。

en: Murukku is commonly eaten during Deepavali. Is it sweet or savoury?
zh: Murukku（麻花卷饼）是屠妖节常见食品，它属于甜食还是咸食？
options: Sweet 甜
Savoury 咸
Both 都有
Neither 都不是
explanation: Murukku is a crunchy savoury snack made with rice flour and spices. Murukku 是以米粉和香料制作的咸味酥脆小吃。

en: Why are many types of festive snacks prepared during Deepavali?
zh: 为什么节庆食品通常会准备很多种类？
options: To show abundance 展现丰盛
To welcome guests 欢迎亲友
To symbolize prosperity 象征富足
All of the above 以上皆是
explanation: A variety of snacks reflects abundance, generosity, and festive hospitality. 多种节庆食品象征丰盛、富足与热情好客。

en: Why do people draw Rangoli at their doorsteps during Deepavali?
zh: 为什么屠妖节时，人们会在家门前绘制 Rangoli？
options: To welcome good luck 欢迎好运
To invite blessings 迎接祝福
To bring light into the home 让光明进入家中
All of the above 以上皆是
explanation: Rangoli is believed to attract prosperity, positivity, and divine blessings. Rangoli 被认为能吸引繁荣、正能量与祝福。

en: Why do many people apply Henna during Deepavali?
zh: 为什么许多人会在屠妖节期间绘制 Henna？
options: It symbolizes auspiciousness 象征吉祥
It brings joy and beauty 增添喜悦与美感
It is part of celebration 属于节庆传统
All of the above 以上皆是
explanation: Henna represents blessings, beauty, and festive happiness. Henna 象征祝福、美丽与节庆的喜悦。

en: What are common greetings exchanged during Deepavali visits?
zh: 屠妖节亲友拜年时常说的祝语是什么？
options: “Happy Deepavali! May light fill your home.” 屠妖节快乐！愿光明照亮您的家。
“May goodness triumph in your heart.” 愿善念常驻心中。
“Wishing you joy and prosperity.” 祝你喜悦与繁荣。
All of the above 以上皆是
explanation: Deepavali greetings focus on light, goodness, joy, and blessings. 屠妖节祝语围绕光明、善念、喜悦与祝福。

en: Why does Deepavali fall on different dates each year?
zh: 为什么屠妖节每年日期不同？
options: It follows the Hindu lunar calendar （因为遵循印度教农历）
It depends on weather conditions （取决于天气）
It is chosen by the government （由政府决定）
It is based on harvest cycles （根据收成周期）
explanation: The Hindu calendar is based on lunar phases, so festival dates shift each year just like Chinese Lunar New Year. 印度教使用农历，因此节日日期会随月亮周期变化，就像华人农历新年一样。

en: Which landmark in Little India is known for its colourful façade and is popular during Deepavali?
zh: 小印度中哪一个地标以其鲜艳的外墙而闻名，并在屠妖节期间特别受欢迎？
options: Sri Mariamman Temple （马里安曼兴都庙）
House of Tan Teng Niah （陈东尼亚故居）
Sultan Mosque （苏丹回教堂）
Buddha Tooth Relic Temple （佛牙寺）
explanation: It’s one of the last surviving Chinese villas in Little India, famous for its bright colours and photo spots. 这是小印度仅存的华人别墅之一，以鲜艳的色彩和拍照景点而闻名。

en: What is the name of the major Hindu temple in Little India where many visit during Deepavali?
zh: 小印度中哪一座主要的兴都庙在屠妖节期间吸引大量访客？
options: Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple （维拉玛卡里雅曼庙）
Sri Srinivasa Perumal Temple （斯里斯里尼瓦沙柏马庙）
Sri Thendayuthapani Temple （登达尤塔帕尼庙）
Sri Krishnan Temple （克里希南庙）
explanation: Located along Serangoon Road, it is one of the most iconic temples in Little India and a key Deepavali worship site. 位于实龙岗路，是小印度最具代表性的兴都庙之一，也是屠妖节的重要祭拜地点。

en: Which festival activity is commonly seen along the streets of Little India during Deepavali?
zh: 屠妖节期间，小印度街道上常见哪一种节庆活动？
options: Dragon boat races （龙舟赛）
Lantern riddles （灯谜）
Street bazaars （街头市集）
Lion dance competitions （舞狮比赛）
explanation: Deepavali brings festive markets selling snacks, clothes, decorations, and traditional items. 屠妖节期间会有节庆市集，售卖零食、服饰、装饰品和传统物品。

en: What is a popular drink served during Deepavali gatherings in Singapore?
zh: 新加坡屠妖节聚会中常见的饮品是什么？
options: Bandung （玫瑰糖奶）
Masala tea （玛莎拉奶茶）
Sugarcane juice （甘蔗汁）
Milo dinosaur （美禄恐龙）
explanation: Masala tea is a spiced Indian milk tea commonly served during festive gatherings. 玛莎拉奶茶是印度香料奶茶，常在节庆聚会中供应。
